summary: Iteration 44 (Phase 4 — LID fallback + ticket merge + ticket-bound quotes) — full backend + frontend E2E pass. 8 new pytest cases (test_iteration_44.py) all green; regression of iter40 (21/21) + iter42 (8/9, 1 obsolete skipped) + iter43 (4/7, 3 pre-existing skips) all green. E2E: ticket #1103 → new-quote-from-ticket-btn opens QuoteEditor with banner 'VINCULADO AO ATENDIMENTO #1103', client locked (no Trocar), modal fits 1280x720, Save creates quote_number=1103, Orcamentos lista shows it; 'Novo Orcamento' button on Orcamentos tab now only shows toast (no editor); ticket-more-btn dropdown contains merge-ticket-btn → opens merge-ticket-modal with 10 merge-target candidates (no destructive action executed).

issues: Footer (Salvar/Salvar e Enviar) requires internal scroll to reach — modal max-h-[90vh] kicks in and uses overflow-y-auto correctly, but on exactly 1280x720 the user MUST scroll the modal a bit to see the action buttons. Acceptable per spec (max-h-[90vh] + scroll), but worth noting for taller screens you would not see this. Buttons are present and functional.

critical_code_review_comments: channels_routes.py _looks_like_lid: heuristic correctly excludes BR (starts 55, 12-13 digits) and triggers only on >=14 digits AND existing recent ticket with same name+connection — robust dual-guard. Good.

crm_routes.py merge endpoint: messages dedup uses set comprehension with truthy filter on wa_message_id — protects against None pollution. Tags merged via $set with concatenation — preserves order, not lost on race. Cross-tenant safe via single 'company_id' filter. Quote re-pointing is a single update_many — atomic enough for current use case.

quotes_routes.py POST /quotes: ticket_id is now mandatory and verified within tenant; second quote on same ticket gets '{N}.M' versioned suffix using a regex on existing quote_numbers. Edge case: deleting quote #N then creating a new one yields '{N}.2' (counts only existing) — acceptable.

AtendimentosPage.js MoreMenu uses onMouseLeave to auto-close dropdown — Playwright force=True clicks can fire mousemove events that close it prematurely. Real users are not affected. Just a test-flakiness note.
OrcamentosPage.js ModalShell with max-h-[90vh] + overflow-y-auto correctly limits modal height; on 1280x720 the user has to scroll a bit to see footer. Consider sticky footer for smaller viewports.

The TestSendWhatsapp.test_phone_required_when_no_client_no_ticket case is now SKIPPED because Phase 4 makes the precondition impossible (quotes always have a ticket). rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Phase 4 features (LID fallback in webhook, merge endpoint, ticket-bound quotes, QuoteEditor responsive modal, banner) all working end-to-end.
